title: Exact Leg-Cut Influence Functional and Emergence of Gaussian Entanglement Theory in a Statistical-Dressing Ladder Model
summary: The emergence of Gaussian effective field theories in low-dimensional quantum systems is traditionally understood through top-down frameworks such as bosonization and Luttinger-liquid theory. However, these approaches typically focus on the long-wavelength degrees of freedom in ways that do not directly track how non-Gaussian lattice-scale correlations are progressively discarded under coarse-graining.
